subject: Your 3AM spiral just lost its power
preview_text: 45 days in, you're not the same person who downloaded this app. Here's what comes next.
body_paragraphs: Remember the night you first opened this app? The ex's name on your phone, the hollow feeling in your chest, the way 3AM felt like a black hole you'd never escape. That version of you is gone now.

You've tracked your moods, logged your no-contact streak, and whispered things to our AI therapist you'd never say out loud. You've seen the data: your average mood has climbed 40% since day one. You're not just surviving breakups anymore—you're the person who walks through them and comes out sharper.

This is email 20 of 20. Not a goodbye, but a graduation. You've earned the power user badge in Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy, and that means you're now part of our ambassador circle—first access to new features, exclusive coping exercises, and a private community of people who get it. Open the app to claim your badge and see the next chapter waiting for you.

Tap 'Open Fresh Start' now to unlock your ambassador tools. P.S. The 3AM spiral still happens, but now you've got emergency mode set up and a 45-day streak of showing up for yourself. That's not luck—that's you.
